attchmntText: Airan Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Airan Limited board approved unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Revenue from operations was 4,678.88 lakh for the quarter and 10,137.08 lakh for the half year. Profit after tax was 284.38 lakh for the quarter and 1,097.58 lakh for the half year. Basic earnings per share was 0.23 for the quarter and 0.88 for the half year. Total assets stood at 16,627.80 lakh as of September 30, 2026. The board meeting occurred on November 14, 2026. Sandeepkumar Vishwanath Agrawal is Chairman and Managing Director. The results include a limited review report from Statutory Auditors Supal Shah and Associates.
